replication.target_description: Replication attempt / Sample #2: participant PSD slopes in the weapon identification task, planned orthogonal contrast of control against the average of use-race and avoid-race conditions; replication of Correll (2008) Study 2 effort manipulation.

notes: Identity verified from canonical text: title Making sense of the noise: Replication difficulties of Correll’s (2008) modulation of 1/f noise in a racial bias task; Christine Madurski and Etienne P. LeBel; DOI 10.3758/s13423-014-0757-4. Primary BRIEF REPORT, Psychon Bull Rev (2015) 22:1135–1141, published online 11 November 2014; matches supplied 2014 reference. Supplied text contains all seven journal pages, methods, results, tables, discussion, and references. No PDF supplied. Only assigned unfinished fields were examined for checkpoint values; other fields are unassigned placeholders. Study correspondence follows explicitly named replication attempts and Sample # labels, not input ordering or numeric matching. Authors’ failed verdict concerns the effort manipulation; successful emergence of general 1/f noise is a different finding. Table 1 explicitly prints N=148, t=-.494, p=.62, and d=-.09 +/- .34 for Sample #2. No metric conversion or N derivation. White-only and non-compliance-exclusion sensitivity analyses and the combined sample are distinct tests. Exclusion evidence: One participant in sample 2 had an extremely high error rate of 83 % ... and was excluded from all analyses.
